open_points.subject: FlowActivation creation (M18) vs flow actions (State 0 K-08 / Primary actions)
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven"; Primary action "activate a flow": "the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"; M18 source: "The kernel, after proof and, for effectful versions, the owner."
open_points.question: Does proving a read-only flow version during compose/prove automatically create a FlowActivation, or is activation created only when the activate action is called?
options: Auto-activate immediately on successful proof (compose/prove path)
Activate only through explicit activate action (read-only just needs no owner decision)
Both paths may create activation, with dedup/no-op rules
open_points.default_guess: Auto-activate immediately when proof succeeds for a read-only version.

open_points.subject: FlowActivation identity used by EffectAttempt authority (M18, M26)
open_points.text: M26: "The authority is named by its identity: ... a flow activation by its position in the store's order (M18)"; M18 candidate fields list no activation id or explicit order field.
open_points.question: What exact model fact identifies a specific FlowActivation record for references (especially from EffectAttempt.authority)?
options: Use an explicit persisted monotonic sequence/store-position field as part of M18
Use composite facts (flow_version_id + activated_at) as identity
open_points.default_guess: Use a persisted monotonic activation sequence/store-position field and reference that.

open_points.subject: Run terminal status when failures coexist with waiting nodes (M19 lifecycle)
open_points.text: M19: "The run is `failed` when no node can run any more and some node failed" and also "status is `awaiting_approval` when any of them waits for the owner's approval, otherwise `pending`."
open_points.question: If at least one node has failed and at least one other node is still waiting (`owner_approval`/`service_unreachable`/`outcome_unknown`), is the run kept waiting or ended `failed`?
options: Waiting statuses take precedence until all waits are resolved/cancelled/refused
`failed` takes precedence as soon as no executable node remains, even if waits exist
open_points.default_guess: Keep the run in waiting status while any waiting point exists; decide `failed` only after waiting points are cleared and no progress is possible.

open_points.subject: NodeExecution referenceability for capture (M06 -> M23)
open_points.text: M06: "captured_from": "the NodeExecution (M23) it was captured from"; M23 has no explicit identifier field and is marked Identity: value.
open_points.question: Which exact facts are the stable reference key for a NodeExecution when another model stores a pointer to it?
options: Define composite key (run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number) as normative unique reference
Store embedded copy instead of reference
open_points.default_guess: Use composite key (run_id, node_id, map_index, attempt_number) as the normative reference.
